   152  /* New output message method - send to VIPS.
   153   */
   154  void
   155  vips__new_output_message( j_common_ptr cinfo )
   156  {
   157          char buffer[JMSG_LENGTH_MAX];
   158
   159          (*cinfo->err->format_message)( cinfo, buffer );
   160          vips_error( "VipsJpeg", _( "%s" ), buffer );
   161
   162  #ifdef DEBUG
   163          printf( "vips__new_output_message: \"%s\"\n", buffer );
   164  #endif /*DEBUG*/
   165
   166          /* This is run for things like file truncated. Signal invalidate to
   167           * force this op out of cache.
   168           */
   169          if( cinfo->client_data )
   170                  vips_foreign_load_invalidate( VIPS_IMAGE( cinfo->client_data ) );
   171  }

   173  /* New error_exit handler.
   174   */
   175  void
   176  vips__new_error_exit( j_common_ptr cinfo )
   177  {
   178          ErrorManager *eman = (ErrorManager *) cinfo->err;
   179
   180  #ifdef DEBUG
   181          printf( "vips__new_error_exit:\n" );
   182  #endif /*DEBUG*/
   183
   184          /* Close the fp if necessary.
   185           */
   186          if( eman->fp ) {
   187                  (void) fclose( eman->fp );
   188                  eman->fp = NULL;
   189          }
   190
   191          /* Send the error message to VIPS. This method is overridden above.
   192           */
   193          (*cinfo->err->output_message)( cinfo );
   194
   195          /* Jump back.
   196           */
   197          longjmp( eman->jmp, 1 );
   198  }

   211  write_destroy( Write *write )
   212  {
   213          jpeg_destroy_compress( &write->cinfo );
   214          VIPS_FREE( write->row_pointer );
   215          VIPS_UNREF( write->inverted );
   216          VIPS_UNREF( write->in );
   217
   218          g_free( write );

   221  static Write *
   222  write_new( VipsImage *in )
   223  {
   224          Write *write;
   225
   226          if( !(write = g_new0( Write, 1 )) )
   227                  return( NULL );
   228
   229          write->in = NULL;
   230          write->row_pointer = NULL;
   231          write->cinfo.err = jpeg_std_error( &write->eman.pub );
   232          write->cinfo.dest = NULL;
   233          write->eman.pub.error_exit = vips__new_error_exit;
   234          write->eman.pub.output_message = vips__new_output_message;
   235          write->eman.fp = NULL;
   236          write->inverted = NULL;
   237

   239                  vips__exif_update( write->in ) ) {
   240                  write_destroy( write );
   241                  return( NULL );
   242          }
   243
   244          return( write );
   245  }
